record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: For which prime Fano threefolds of index 1 or index 2 does the Kuznetsov component admit Serre-invariant stability conditions?

artifact.category_tag: Serre-invariant stability conditions on Kuznetsov components
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth prime Fano threefold over $\mathbb{C}$, i.e., a smooth projective threefold of Picard rank $1$ with ample anticanonical class $-K_X = i_X H$, where $H$ is the ample generator of $\mathrm{Pic}(X)$ and $i_X \in \{1,2\}$ is the Fano index. Associated to $X$ is the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X) \subset D^b(X)$, defined as the right orthogonal complement of an exceptional collection: for $i_X = 2$, $\mathcal{K}u(X) = \langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(H)\rangle^{\perp}$; for $i_X = 1$, $\mathcal{K}u(X) = \langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{U}_X^{\vee}\rangle^{\perp}$ when an appropriate tautological bundle $\mathcal{U}_X$ exists, and $\mathcal{K}u(X) = \langle \mathcal{O}_X\rangle^{\perp}$ in the remaining small-genus cases. Let $S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)}$ denote the Serre functor of $\mathcal{K}u(X)$. A Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma = (\mathcal{A}, Z)$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is called Serre-invariant if $S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)} \cdot \sigma = \sigma \cdot \widetilde{g}$ for some $\widetilde{g} \in \widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}^+_2(\mathbb{R})$, i.e., $\sigma$ is preserved by the Serre functor up to the action of the universal cover of $\mathrm{GL}^+_2(\mathbb{R})$ on the stability manifold $\mathrm{Stab}(\mathcal{K}u(X))$.

Determine, for every deformation family of smooth prime Fano threefolds of index $1$ or index $2$ (parameterised by the index together with the degree/genus), whether $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ admits a Serre-invariant Bridgeland stability condition.
artifact.status_search_result: Existence of Serre-invariant stability conditions on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ has been established for all prime Fano threefolds of index $2$ (del Pezzo threefolds) and for index $1$ prime Fano threefolds of genus $\ge 6$ as well as for the small-genus cases studied by Bayer–Lahoz–Macrì–Stellari, Pertusi–Yang, and Feyzbakhsh–Pertusi. Recent work (e.g. arXiv:2310.16950 and follow-ups) describes the connected component of Serre-invariant stability conditions and uniqueness results. While the existence problem is essentially settled in many index $1$ and index $2$ cases, a complete uniform answer covering every prime Fano threefold deformation type is not yet fully formalised in the literature, so the question is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: All Serre-invariant stability conditions on the Kuznetsov component form a contractible connected component of the stability manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Serre-invariant stability conditions exist and have been classified for prime Fano threefolds in many index 1 and index 2 cases.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions on Kuznetsov components of Gushel–Mukai threefolds and Serre functor
status_evidence.snippet: Stability conditions on the Kuznetsov component of GM threefolds, constructed by BLMS, are preserved by the Serre functor up to the action of the universal cover of GL+_2(R).
status_evidence.claim: Existence proved for Gushel–Mukai (index 1, genus 6) threefolds.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A general criterion ensures that a fractional Calabi–Yau category of dimension at most 2 admits a unique Serre-invariant stability condition.
status_evidence.claim: Existence and uniqueness proved for cubic threefolds (index 2).
